summary.en: Prepare a Python environment, check the four libraries and choose between scripts and notebooks.
summary.bn: Python পরিবেশ তৈরি করো, চারটি লাইব্রেরি যাচাই করো আর script বা notebook বেছে নাও।

notes: Python syntax works on 3.10+; Python 3.12 is recommended.
Use NumPy 2.0+, pandas 2.2+, scikit-learn 1.5+ and Matplotlib 3.8+ on a compatible Python.

sections.title: Draw a box around the project

examples.title: Import the four tools
examples.explanationHtml: The import names differ from some installation names: scikit-learn is imported as sklearn. Agg draws to files. The three sizes average 4.0 cm; no learning rule has been fitted.

examples.title: Check the minimum versions
examples.explanationHtml: The program reads each installed version, then compares its major and minor numbers with the course minimum. Printing pass/fail keeps the result useful across compatible patch releases. To see the full number, print installed inside the loop.

examples.title: A script that starts from known data
examples.explanationHtml: All five inputs are visible in the script. The function returns a result and main prints it. Re-running cannot inherit an old list from an earlier notebook cell.

practice.title: List the import names
practice.statementHtml: Read one installation name: numpy, pandas, scikit-learn or matplotlib. Print its Python import name on one line.
hints: Three names stay the same; scikit-learn maps to sklearn.

practice.title: Check a stated Python version
practice.statementHtml: Read two nonnegative integers, major and minor, on one line. Print supported if the pair is at least (3, 10), otherwise upgrade. This checks the stated course baseline, not installed library compatibility.
hints: Compare integer pairs, not decimal numbers like 3.9 and 3.10.

practice.title: Find the missing interpreter
practice.statementHtml: A terminal imports pandas successfully. A notebook says ModuleNotFoundError. Explain two checks before reinstalling anything.
hints: An editor or notebook chooses its own Python executable.
practice.answerHtml: Print sys.executable in the working terminal and the failing notebook. Different paths reveal different interpreters. Select the intended environment as the notebook kernel, or install with that kernel’s Python. Restart the kernel and re-run the import. Installing repeatedly into the terminal environment cannot repair a different kernel.

practice.title: Choose a place to work
practice.statementHtml: Mina needs offline work tomorrow. Rafi needs a quick shared demonstration today. Compare a local script, Jupyter and Google Colab for these needs.
hints: Consider network access, saved files and cell execution order.
practice.answerHtml: Mina can prepare a local environment and copy the CSVs before going offline. A local script runs top to bottom; local Jupyter offers cells and nearby plots. Colab offers hosted notebooks in a browser, useful for sharing a demonstration, but needs a connection and its session storage is temporary. Neither notebook platform guarantees the course library versions without checking.

quiz.prompt: Which environment keeps this course’s packages apart from another project?
options: A virtual environment created for this project
quiz.explanation: A virtual environment has its own installed packages. It does not create a separate computer or change the data.

quiz.prompt: Why use python -m pip after activating an environment?
options: It removes the need for Python
It runs pip with the selected Python interpreter
It downloads the course CSVs automatically
It guarantees every future version is compatible
quiz.explanation: The selected interpreter runs the pip module. A bare pip command can belong to a different installation.

quiz.prompt: Which installation name pairs with import sklearn?
quiz.explanation: The package is installed as scikit-learn and imported as sklearn. Installation names and import names need not match.

quiz.prompt: A notebook ran cells 1, 3, 2 yesterday. What is the most useful first reproducibility check?
options: Restart the kernel and run all cells in order
quiz.explanation: Restarting clears old variables. Running in order exposes a dependency that the saved screen may have hidden.

quiz.prompt: Mina will lose her connection tomorrow. Which prepared setup can still run the CSV script?
options: A local environment with the libraries and CSV already copied
A browser link to an uncopied dataset
quiz.explanation: Local Python can run without a network after its requirements and data are present. Hosted notebooks need service access.

quiz.prompt: Why check library versions at the start of an ML project?
options: To make invented data become real
To record which implementations and APIs the work used
To guarantee the model is fair
quiz.explanation: Versions help explain API and numerical differences. They do not establish data quality or fairness.

quiz.prompt: What does matplotlib.use("Agg") enable in these scripts?
options: Drawing and saving figures without an interactive window
quiz.explanation: Agg is a file-oriented plotting backend. Set it before importing pyplot.

quiz.prompt: After assigning a fresh fruit count, what value survives the reassignment?
quiz.explanation: Assignment binds count to the latest value, 3. It does not add to the old value.

quiz.prompt: Does this pair of version integers meet the Python baseline?
quiz.explanation: Tuple comparison checks 3 against 3, then 9 against 10. The result is False; version numbers are not decimal fractions.

quiz.prompt: How many cards does this fresh script count on each run?
quiz.explanation: The list contains five entries. Its largest value and its sum are different questions.

keyPoints.en: A virtual environment keeps project installations separate.
keyPoints.bn: virtual environment-এ প্রকল্পের package আলাদা থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Install through the Python interpreter you intend to run.
keyPoints.bn: যে Python চালাবে, সেটি দিয়েই package install করো।

keyPoints.en: The installation name scikit-learn maps to the import name sklearn.
keyPoints.bn: scikit-learn install করে sklearn নামে import করতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Check notebook kernels when imports disagree with the terminal.
keyPoints.bn: terminal আর notebook-এ import না মিললে kernel-এর Python দেখো।

keyPoints.en: Restarting and running all cells exposes hidden notebook state.
keyPoints.bn: kernel restart করে সব cell চালালে লুকিয়ে থাকা পুরোনো মানের সমস্যা ধরা পড়ে।

keyPoints.en: Preserve scripts, data and exact versions for reproduction.
keyPoints.bn: আবার একই কাজ করতে script, data আর সঠিক version একসঙ্গে রাখো।

examQuestions.question: Explain why python -m pip is preferable to an unqualified pip command when several Python versions exist.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The selected Python executes its own pip module, linking installation to that interpreter. For example, an activated environment’s python -m pip installs into that environment. A bare pip may resolve to another executable on PATH. Check sys.executable and python -m pip --version when imports disagree.

examQuestions.question: Write a reproducible plan for running the fruit script on a second computer.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
1. Install a compatible Python, preferably the same 3.12 release.
  2. Create a new virtual environment and install the four libraries.
  3. Record Python and exact library versions; preserve these versions for close reproduction.
  4. Copy the script and the course CSV rather than fetching replacement data.
  5. Run the script from its data directory and compare the numeric result.

examQuestions.question: A notebook computes total = 10 in cell A, total += 5 in cell B, then prints total in cell C. What prints after A,B,C? What prints if B,C are run again? Explain the repair.
examQuestions.answerHtml: After A then B, total is 15, so C prints 15. Re-running B changes the existing value to 20; C now prints 20. Restart and run all cells in order to expose hidden state. For this task, make B assign from an explicit input instead of repeatedly changing a shared accumulator.
